benefits: Rudrabhishek at Kashi Vishwanath — Mahadev's own eternal city
Gangajal drawn from the Ganga at Varanasi offered in your name
Removes fear, ill health, and untimely misfortune (Mahamrityunjaya blessings)
Kashi is the foremost kshetra for pacifying Pitra, Kaal Sarp and Shani doshas
Brings marital harmony and blessings for an early, suitable match
Grants inner peace, courage, and progress toward moksha

faqs.question: When exactly is this puja performed?
faqs.answer: On Monday, 3 August 2026 — the first Savan Somwar of Shravan 2026. The exact timing is confirmed with you on WhatsApp before the puja begins.

faqs.question: Will I get the puja video?
faqs.answer: Yes. The full puja video, with your name and gotra taken during the Sankalp, is shared with you on WhatsApp after the puja.

faqs.question: What is Rudrabhishek?
faqs.answer: Rudrabhishek is the ceremonial bathing of the Shivling with Gangajal, milk, panchamrit and sacred offerings while Rudri path and Shiv mantras are chanted.

faqs.question: Is prasad included?
faqs.answer: Prasad is optional. You can add a blessed prasad box for ₹298 during booking and it will be couriered to your home after the puja.

poojaBenefitsDescription:
Verified pandits perform Rudrabhishek of Baba Vishwanath on your behalf at Kashi on the first Savan Somwar with traditional Vedic rituals.
A personalised Sankalp is done in your name and gotra so the puja is dedicated to you and your family.
Offerings include Gangajal drawn from the Ganga at Varanasi, milk, bel patra, dhatura, bhang, white flowers and chandan, with Rudri path and Mahamrityunjaya mantra chanting.
You receive the puja video with your name & gotra on WhatsApp, and can have blessed prasad couriered to your home.

poojaDescription.heading: Purpose of Puja
poojaDescription.description:
To seek the blessings of Baba Vishwanath — Mahadev as the Lord of the Universe, worshipped at Kashi Vishwanath, among the most revered of the twelve Jyotirlingas.

Kashi (Varanasi) is held to be Shiva's own city, said to rest upon his trishul and to stand untouched even at the dissolution of the world. The month of Shravan (Savan) is his most beloved month, and Savan Somwar is its most powerful day.

poojaDescription.heading: Best Time to Perform
poojaDescription.description:
Day: Monday, 3 August 2026 — the first Savan Somwar

Shravan month runs from 30 July to 28 August 2026. Mondays of this month are considered the single most auspicious time in the year to worship Mahadev, and the first Savan Somwar is held to be the most fruitful of them all.

poojaDescription.heading: What is performed
poojaDescription.description: Verified pandits perform the complete Vedic vidhi at Shree Kashi Vishwanath Temple — Sankalp in your name & gotra, Rudrabhishek of the Jyotirlinga with Gangajal and panchamrit, Rudri path, Mahamrityunjaya mantra chanting, and Shiv aarti.

poojaDescription.heading: Offerings made on your behalf
poojaDescription.description:
• Gangajal drawn from the Ganga at Varanasi, and raw milk abhishek

• Bel patra, dhatura, bhang and white aak flowers

• Panchamrit — milk, curd, ghee, honey and sugar

• Chandan, bhasma, akshata and white flowers

• Rudri path and Mahamrityunjaya mantra chanting

poojaDescription.heading: What you will receive
poojaDescription.description:
• Personalised Sankalp performed in your name & gotra

• Full puja video shared on WhatsApp

• Photos of the offerings made in your name

• Blessed prasad couriered to your home (optional)
